raw_description:
Position Type: Full-time

Location: Philippines (Remote)

Schedule: Monday-Friday, at least 4 hours overlap with Netherlands time

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Our client is a Netherlands-based company operating in the fitness and sports performance space. The company produces engaging, high-impact content that connects with fitness-focused audiences across digital and social media platforms.

As the business continues to expand its content output, it is building its internal creative capabilities to support its growing marketing needs and maintain a consistent, compelling visual presence.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our client is seeking a highly skilled and self-sufficient Video Editor to serve as the company's dedicated in-house editing resource. You will create high-impact ads, reels, and occasional long-form content, primarily within the fitness and sports performance space. This role is ideal for a proactive all-round editor who can produce polished, engaging content with minimal supervision.

This is a 100% remote position.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Video Editing: Produce high-impact ads, reels, and other video content
- Long-Form Editing: Edit occasional longer-form content, including vlogs and episodic videos.
- Creative Storytelling: Select compelling footage and apply strong hooks, pacing, transitions, and sound design.
- Motion Graphics: Incorporate text animations, graphics, and visual effects where needed.
- Brand Alignment: Follow the brand's visual style and translate creative direction into polished content.
- High-Volume Production: Manage varying output requirements, from multiple short-form pieces to longer weekly edits.
- Independent Execution: Own the editing process with minimal supervision and proactively manage priorities.
- Creative Collaboration: Work with the internal videographer and external agency, incorporating feedback and revisions.
- Platform Optimization: Adapt videos to the appropriate formats and specifications for ads and social media.
- Trend Awareness: Stay current with editing trends, particularly in fitness and sports performance content.

COMPETENCIES AND QUALIFICATIONS

Must-Have

- Proven experience editing high-impact ads, reels, and social media videos.
- Strong portfolio demonstrating excellent editing, pacing, and visual storytelling.
- Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve.
- Ability to edit both short-form and longer-form content, including vlogs.
- Highly self-sufficient, proactive, and capable of working with minimal supervision.
- Strong organizational skills and ability to manage varying content demands.
- Excellent English communication skills.

Nice-to-Have

- Motion graphics and animation experience.
- Interest in and understanding of fitness, sports, or performance content.
- Experience creating performance-focused video ads.
- Familiarity with CapCut and other social media editing tools.

WHAT WE OFFER

- 100% Remote Work
- 13th Month Pay
- Healthcare (HMO)
- Comprehensive Fringe Benefits package
- Paid Service Incentive Lead (SIL)
- Paid Philippines Holidays
- Free Learning and Development Programs

APPLICATION PROCESS

We understand that searching for a new job can be challenging, and we're here to support you every step of the way. Our goal is to make the process as transparent and respectful as possible.

Typically, the interview process includes a Recruiter Interview, Client Interview, and Practical Test, but this may vary depending on the role. Throughout each stage, we'll keep you informed and provide feedback as quickly as we can, ensuring you feel valued and supported throughout your journey with us.
